key_insight: FinTradeBench introduces a benchmark that jointly tests LLMs on heterogeneous financial reasoning by combining company fundamentals (regulatory filings) with computed trading signals, revealing gaps in LLM numerical, temporal and multimodal financial reasoning.
problem_solved: Existing financial QA benchmarks focus narrowly on balance-sheet data and static facts; FinTradeBench addresses the need to evaluate models on real-world financial decision-making that requires integrating fundamentals, price dynamics, and reasoning under uncertainty.
method: Curate a multimodal dataset linking regulatory filing fundamentals with time-series trading signals (price, returns, volatility, technical indicators) for the same companies and periods.

Define diverse task suite (e.g., financial QA, direction/return forecasting, portfolio allocation, risk assessment, counterfactual reasoning) with standardized metrics for accuracy, economic utility and calibration.
Benchmark LLMs using prompting, chain-of-thought, and baseline finetuned models to measure performance gaps and failure modes in numerical, temporal, and causal reasoning.
impact: Provides a realistic, reproducible way to evaluate and improve LLMs for finance — enabling practitioners to identify model weaknesses in real-world financial decisions and drive development of more reliable, numerically-capable models.
visual_elements: Schematic: heterogeneous inputs (filings + trading time series) feeding into an LLM, producing decisions (forecasts, allocations, explanations).
Benchmark task grid: icons for tasks (QA, forecasting, portfolio, risk) with example metrics per task.
Performance bar chart: baseline LLMs vs specialized models highlighting gaps in numeric/temporal reasoning and economic utility.
Failure-mode callouts: example prompts and model errors (miscomputed ratios, temporal misalignment, overconfident predictions).
paper_title: FinTradeBench: A Financial Reasoning Benchmark for LLMs
paper_authors: Yogesh Agrawal, Aniruddha Dutta, Md Mahadi Hasan, Santu Karmaker, Aritra Dutta
